scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm --workspace=server run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=shared && tsc -p server/tsconfig.test.json && npm --workspace=web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=shared && tsc -p server/tsconfig.test.json && vitest run
